item.text: {"text":"Removing the compatibility aliases is not acceptable yet. The migration renamed three public fields while retaining those aliases. The familiar framing is that client migration is nearly complete; the more precise conclusion is that twelve of fourteen known clients have migrated, while the status of two remains unknown. The tests are not broadly inadequate; they are inadequate for proving safe alias removal because integration coverage includes the twelve migrated clients, not the two of unknown status. The consequential distinction is simple: progress is not confirmation. Do not remove the aliases until both remaining client owners confirm migration."}
